name: Litepod MCP
description: Reviews Litepod exec calls that start or stop applications, change environment variables, domains, compose files or source, redeploy, roll back, delete projects and applications, or deploy code from a repository, ZIP or Compose file. Reads through get stay on Guard's usual handling. Litepod gives each organization its own MCP endpoint, so connect and turn this on for each organization you use. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use get to read projects, applications, deployments, logs and domains, which does not change anything.
Prefer exec proposals that Litepod asks a person to confirm over start and stop, which run immediately.
